summary: Backend-only test iteration for RythuMitra Smart Precision Farming. Created pytest suite covering all 15 required scenarios across auth, fields, devices, sensors, advice (rule + Claude), planner, and _id leak checks. 22/22 tests passed (100%). Claude Sonnet 4.5 advice endpoint successfully returned recommendations (either via Claude or graceful fallback to rules). Sensor readings drift correctly over a 5s window. No _id or password_hash leaks detected in any endpoint response.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 593 lines and starting to approach the 700-line soft limit. Consider splitting into routers (auth.py, fields.py, sensors.py, advice.py, planner.py, voice.py) before adding more endpoints.
control_device and planner/reminders use Form(...) while other POSTs use JSON. Consider standardizing on JSON for consistency with the rest of the API.
voice_transcribe uses synchronous OpenAI client (blocking) inside an async endpoint — consider running in a thread executor to avoid blocking the event loop.
planner/complete does not require the task to belong to the current user's cycle — the {'user_id': user['id']} filter is present so this is fine; noted as verified.
seed_data_creation: Seeded user 9876543210/pass1234 was already registered (409 handled). Fixture falls back to login. No additional seed data created; all tests operate on the pre-seeded 3 fields + 1 device + 1 Wheat cycle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_rythumitra_backend.py. Use BASE_URL from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Seeded credentials: mobile 9876543210 / password pass1234. The `auth` fixture is idempotent (register-or-login). test_planner_complete_task marks one pending task complete each run — this is safe because progress simply advances; if all tasks get completed over many runs, planner endpoint may return today_task=None. Currently ~5-6 tasks remain uncompleted, so this is fine for the next several iterations.
